## `funcdconfig.yaml`

| Key | Type and limits | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiVersion` | string, must be `funcd.io/v1alpha1` |  |  |
| `kind` | string, must be `FuncdConfig` |  |  |
| `server.listenAddr` | string | `127.0.0.1:8080` | The address that the control plane's API listens on. An address off loopback needs auth.credentials or a token of your own in auth.token. Variable: `FUNCD_LISTEN_ADDR`. |
| `server.dataPlaneAddr` | string | `127.0.0.1:0` | The address that the data plane listens on, where functions, Routes and Sites answer. Port 0 takes a free port. With server.auth.edge on, an address off loopback needs a credential of your own too. Variable: `FUNCD_DATA_PLANE_ADDR`. |
| `server.baseDomain` | string | `localhost` | The domain under which every namespace but default answers, as &lt;namespace&gt;.&lt;baseDomain&gt;. funcd checks it at start. Variable: `FUNCD_BASE_DOMAIN`. |
| `server.tls.enabled` | boolean | `false` | When true, both listeners serve HTTPS. Variable: `FUNCD_TLS_ENABLED`. |
| `server.tls.mode` | string, one of `selfsigned`, `provided` or `acme` |  | Where the certificate comes from: selfsigned, made by funcd with no network; provided, the files certFile and keyFile; or acme, from an ACME server. Empty means selfsigned. Variable: `FUNCD_TLS_MODE`. |
| `server.tls.hosts` | list of strings |  | The host names that the certificate covers. Variable: `FUNCD_TLS_HOSTS=a,b`. |
| `server.tls.certFile` | string |  | The certificate file, in provided mode. Variable: `FUNCD_TLS_CERT_FILE`. |
| `server.tls.keyFile` | string |  | The private key file, in provided mode. Variable: `FUNCD_TLS_KEY_FILE`. |
| `server.tls.email` | string |  | The contact email of the ACME account, in acme mode. Variable: `FUNCD_TLS_EMAIL`. |
| `server.tls.caDir` | string |  | The directory URL of the ACME server, in acme mode. Empty means Let's Encrypt. Variable: `FUNCD_TLS_CA_DIR`. |
| `server.limits.ratePerMin` | integer, at least 0 | `0` | The requests per minute that the data plane lets each key make. 0 turns the rate limit off. Variable: `FUNCD_LIMITS_RATE_PER_MIN`. |
| `server.limits.burst` | integer, at least 0 | `0` | How many requests a key may make in a row before its rate applies. 0 means as many as server.limits.ratePerMin. Variable: `FUNCD_LIMITS_BURST`. |
| `server.limits.key` | string, one of `clientIP` or `function` |  | What the rate limit counts per: clientIP, each client address, or function, each function called. Empty means clientIP. Variable: `FUNCD_LIMITS_KEY`. |
| `server.limits.maxBodyBytes` | integer, at least 0 | `0` | The largest request body, in bytes, that the data plane accepts; a larger one gets 413. 0 turns the cap off. Variable: `FUNCD_LIMITS_MAX_BODY_BYTES`. |
| `server.limits.maxInFlight` | integer, at least 0 | `0` | The most requests that the data plane serves at once; one more gets 503. 0 turns the cap off. Variable: `FUNCD_LIMITS_MAX_IN_FLIGHT`. |
| `server.limits.maxKeys` | integer, at least 1 | `4096` | The most keys whose rate the data plane tracks at once. It has no off switch. Variable: `FUNCD_LIMITS_MAX_KEYS`. |
| `server.auth.edge` | boolean | `false` | When true, the data plane authenticates a call to a target whose stance is authenticated with the control plane's credentials, and authorizes it with its policies. When false, such a call gets 401. An open target answers either way. Variable: `FUNCD_AUTH_EDGE`. |
| `server.observability.metrics` | boolean | `false` | When true, the data plane counts each target's requests, errors and durations. Variable: `FUNCD_OBS_METRICS`. |
| `server.observability.accessLog` | boolean | `false` | When true, the data plane logs each request. Variable: `FUNCD_OBS_ACCESS_LOG`. |
| `server.observability.trace` | boolean | `false` | When true, the data plane starts a trace span for each request. Variable: `FUNCD_OBS_TRACE`. |
| `server.shaping.cors.allowOrigins` | list of strings |  | The origins that a browser may call the data plane from. Variable: `FUNCD_SHAPING_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS=a,b`. |
| `server.shaping.cors.allowMethods` | list of strings |  | The methods that a cross-origin call may use. Variable: `FUNCD_SHAPING_CORS_ALLOW_METHODS=a,b`. |
| `server.shaping.cors.allowHeaders` | list of strings |  | The request headers that a cross-origin call may send. Variable: `FUNCD_SHAPING_CORS_ALLOW_HEADERS=a,b`. |
| `server.shaping.cors.maxAgeSeconds` | integer, at least 0 | `0` | How long, in seconds, a browser may keep the answer to a CORS preflight request. Variable: `FUNCD_SHAPING_CORS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS`. |
| `server.shaping.headers.set` | map of string to string |  | The response headers that the data plane sets, by name. Each name must be a valid header name. The variable splits pairs at commas, so a value that holds a comma needs the file. Variable: `FUNCD_SHAPING_HEADERS_SET=k1=v1,k2=v2`. |
| `server.shaping.headers.remove` | list of strings |  | The response headers that the data plane removes. Variable: `FUNCD_SHAPING_HEADERS_REMOVE=a,b`. |
| `server.shaping.compression` | boolean | `false` | When true, the data plane compresses responses with gzip. Variable: `FUNCD_SHAPING_COMPRESSION`. |
| `server.network.egress` | boolean | `false` | When true, workers' outbound traffic is denied by default, and what their EgressPolicies allow goes through the egress gateway. Linux with containerd only; elsewhere it does nothing. Variable: `FUNCD_NETWORK_EGRESS`. |
| `server.network.egressGatewayPort` | integer, 0 to 65535 | `0` | The port of the egress gateway on the workers' bridge, where their outbound TCP is redirected. Required when server.network.egress is on. Variable: `FUNCD_NETWORK_EGRESS_GATEWAY_PORT`. |
| `server.network.dnsForwarderPort` | integer, 0 to 65535 | `0` | The port of the DNS forwarder on the bridge address. A worker's DNS goes only to it, and it answers only the names that an EgressPolicy domain rule allows. 0 runs neither the forwarder nor the gateway, and nothing goes out, DNS included. Variable: `FUNCD_NETWORK_DNS_FORWARDER_PORT`. |
| `server.network.dnsResolver` | string |  | The upstream resolver that the DNS forwarder asks. Variable: `FUNCD_NETWORK_DNS_RESOLVER`. |
| `server.network.internalAllow` | list of strings |  | The addresses on the node, as host:port, that workers may reach directly. Variable: `FUNCD_NETWORK_INTERNAL_ALLOW=a,b`. |
| `server.network.workerSyncInterval` | string | `2s` | How often the egress rules follow the workers that start and stop, as a positive duration such as 2s. Variable: `FUNCD_NETWORK_WORKER_SYNC_INTERVAL`. |
| `server.shutdownTimeout` | string | `15s` | How long funcd waits at shutdown for HTTP requests, Sensors and workflow runs to finish, as a positive duration such as 15s. Variable: `FUNCD_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT`. |
| `storage.mode` | string, one of `file` or `memory` | `file` | Variable: `FUNCD_STORAGE_MODE`. |

## `funcd`

```text
funcd [flags]

funcd — the single-binary serverless platform daemon
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string |  | path to funcdconfig.yaml (else $FUNCD_CONFIG, ./funcdconfig.yaml, /etc/funcd/funcdconfig.yaml) |
| `--memory` | bool | `false` | run fully in memory (ephemeral — no disk); default is file-backed/durable |

## `funcd bench`

```text
funcd bench [flags]

bench runs the funcd sustainability harness in-process by default (memory+file substrate, RSS). --containerd runs only the cgroup-footprint lane; --doctor reports whether the containerd lane can run and warns on a live daemon (it never installs anything). --containerd and --doctor are mutually exclusive. Run it on a dedicated/idle box.
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--backends` | string | `memory,file` | comma-separated substrates |
| `--cni-bin-dir` | string | `/opt/cni/bin` | CNI plugin dir (with --containerd) |
| `--cni-conf-dir` | string | `/etc/cni/net.d` | CNI conflist dir (with --containerd) |
| `--concurrency` | int | `8` | load workers |
| `--containerd` | bool | `false` | run only the containerd cgroup-footprint lane (Linux + root + containerd/crun/CNI + curated image) |
| `--containerd-socket` | string |  | external containerd socket (with --containerd); "" (default) = funcd brings its own privately-managed containerd |
| `--density` | int | `5` | extra warm functions for the density sweep |
| `--doctor` | bool | `false` | report whether the lanes can run + warn on a live daemon — checks only, never installs/spins a VM/ships Lima |
| `--duration` | duration | `5s` | load phase per backend |
| `--image-prefix` | string | `funcd/runtime-` | curated image prefix (with --containerd) |
| `--mem-budget-mb` | int | `16384` | function-memory budget for the verdict |
| `--out` | string | `bench` | output dir for the report |
| `--pool-shim` | string |  | path to the pooled worker_threads shim (default: the embedded pool shim; a missing path skips the comparison) |
| `--python` | string |  | python ≥3.14 for the Python pool comparison; default auto-detect, none found ⇒ skip |
| `--shim` | string |  | path to the node runtime shim (default: the embedded shim) |
| `--snapshotter` | string | `overlayfs` | containerd snapshotter (with --containerd) |
| `--subnet-cidr` | string | `10.63.0.0/16` | lateral bridge subnet (with --containerd) |
| `--target-fns` | int | `100` | agents to size for |

## `funcd completion`

```text
funcd completion

Generate the autocompletion script for funcd for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.
```

## `funcd completion bash`

```text
funcd completion bash

Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(funcd completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	funcd completion bash > /etc/bash_completion.d/funcd

#### macOS:

	funcd completion bash > $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/funcd

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-descriptions` | bool | `false` | disable completion descriptions |

## `funcd completion fish`

```text
funcd completion fish [flags]

Generate the autocompletion script for the fish shell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	funcd completion fish | source

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

	funcd completion fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/funcd.fish

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-descriptions` | bool | `false` | disable completion descriptions |

## `funcd completion powershell`

```text
funcd completion powershell [flags]

Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	funcd completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-descriptions` | bool | `false` | disable completion descriptions |

## `funcd completion zsh`

```text
funcd completion zsh [flags]

Generate the autocompletion script for the zsh shell.

If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need
to enable it.  You can execute the following once:

	echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" >> ~/.zshrc

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source <(funcd completion zsh)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	funcd completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_funcd"

#### macOS:

	funcd completion zsh > $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/_funcd

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-descriptions` | bool | `false` | disable completion descriptions |

## `funcd help`

```text
funcd help [command]

Help provides help for any command in the application.
Simply type funcd help [path to command] for full details.
```

## `funcd install`

```text
funcd install [flags]

install lays down crun + the private containerd and writes + enables ONE funcd.service systemd unit (funcd is the service; containerd is its managed child — no separate unit). It is idempotent. --print dry-runs: it prints the version-stamped unit and touches nothing.
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--print` | bool | `false` | dry-run: print the version-stamped funcd.service unit and exit, touching nothing |

## `funcd restore`

```text
funcd restore

List, inspect and restore platform backup generations (offline; the restored platform boots held)
```

## `funcd restore blob`

```text
funcd restore blob [<generation>] [flags]

Restore the blob store: a mirror generation into the empty store, or --at a time on a versioned blob.target
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--at` | string |  | restore every key of a versioned blob.target to its version at this RFC 3339 time |
| `--config` | string |  | path to funcdconfig.yaml (as the daemon locates it) |
| `--credentials-file` | string |  | the operator's restore credential for an s3:// target (never backup.credentialsFile) |
| `--escrow` | string |  | the escrow directory holding the secrets key and master secret |
| `--from` | string |  | the backup target to read (default backup.target) |
| `--identity` | stringArray | `[]` | an age identity file that opens the generation (repeatable) |
| `--store-credentials-file` | string |  | the operator's credential for blob.target (default blob.credentialsFile); --at needs the version reads |
| `--timeline` | string |  | keep only this timeline and those it descends from |

## `funcd restore inspect`

```text
funcd restore inspect <point> [flags]

Show a generation: manifest, keys needed, version verdict, counts, evidence; one object; a diff
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string |  | path to funcdconfig.yaml (as the daemon locates it) |
| `--credentials-file` | string |  | the operator's restore credential for an s3:// target (never backup.credentialsFile) |
| `--diff` | string |  | list per kind the objects added, removed or changed since this point |
| `--escrow` | string |  | the escrow directory holding the secrets key and master secret |
| `--from` | string |  | the backup target to read (default backup.target) |
| `--identity` | stringArray | `[]` | an age identity file that opens the generation (repeatable) |
| `--kv` | bool | `false` | show a KV point &lt;chain&gt;/&lt;segment&gt; of the kv/ chains |
| `--object` | string |  | print one object, &lt;Kind&gt;/&lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;, for `funcdctl apply -f` |
| `-o`, `--output` | string | `yaml` | output format: yaml or json |
| `--reveal-secrets` | bool | `false` | print Secret values (with --object and --secrets-key) |
| `--secrets-key` | string |  | the escrowed secrets key file, to decode Secrets (--object) |
| `--timeline` | string |  | keep only this timeline and those it descends from |

## `funcd restore run`

```text
funcd restore run <point> [flags]

Restore a generation into the empty data directories; funcd then boots held until `funcdctl hold release`
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string |  | path to funcdconfig.yaml (as the daemon locates it) |
| `--credentials-file` | string |  | the operator's restore credential for an s3:// target (never backup.credentialsFile) |
| `--escrow` | string |  | the escrow directory holding the secrets key and master secret |
| `--from` | string |  | the backup target to read (default backup.target) |
| `--identity` | stringArray | `[]` | an age identity file that opens the generation (repeatable) |
| `--new-master-secret` | bool | `false` | restore without the generation's master secret: the credentials derived from it change |
| `--timeline` | string |  | keep only this timeline and those it descends from |

## `funcd safe-mode`

```text
funcd safe-mode

Leave safe mode (held after repeated unclean starts, stopped after twice as many)
```

## `funcd safe-mode reset`

```text
funcd safe-mode reset [flags]

Clear the unclean-start count after safe mode stopped funcd; the next start is held
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string |  | path to funcdconfig.yaml (as the daemon locates it) |

## `funcd uninstall`

```text
funcd uninstall

Remove the funcd systemd service (reverses install; idempotent)
```

## `funcd upgrade`

```text
funcd upgrade <new-binary> [flags]

Install new-binary over this funcd: a pre-upgrade generation first, the old binary kept at <self>.previous
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config` | string |  | path to funcdconfig.yaml (as the daemon locates it) |
| `--no-snapshot` | bool | `false` | upgrade without a pre-upgrade generation: no way back to this version |
| `--unit` | string | `funcd.service` | the systemd unit to stop and start ("" when the operator stops and starts funcd) |

## `funcd version`

```text
funcd version

Print the build identity and exit
```
